name: China State Construction Engineering Corporation Limited
summary: China State Construction Engineering Corporation Limited operates as a comprehensive construction and real estate enterprise, primarily focused on the Chinese market. The company structures its diverse operations across five key segments: Building Construction Engineering; Infrastructure Construction and Investment; Real Estate Development and Investment; Prospecting and Design; and Other activities. Its extensive construction portfolio includes residential properties and a vast range of infrastructure projects such as urban rail transit systems, high-speed railways, bridges, expressways, municipal roads, integrated urban pipe corridors, port and waterway facilities, power generation plants, mining installations, metallurgical sites, petrochemical complexes, airports, and nuclear power stations. Furthermore, its real estate division manages property development, financing, and investment for various ventures, including integrated urban construction initiatives. The company also offers specialized services in architectural design, urban planning, engineering surveys, and public utility design, encompassing distinctive areas like airports, hotels, sports facilities, exhibition venues, historical architecture restoration, and super high-rise buildings. Additionally, its business interests extend to building science and technology, water environmental protection, e-commerce, and financial services. Founded in 1982, the company maintains its headquarters in Beijing, China, and functions as a subsidiary of the larger China State Construction Engineering Corporation.
